purpose: Review a finite issuer shipping-fleet, vessel-orderbook, charter-coverage, off-hire, dry-dock, maintenance, sale and demolition lifecycle domain before source rows, values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.supply_chain_boundary: Campaign163 freezes customers, suppliers, orders and procurement. Cargo customers or shipyards do not establish vessel identity, charter terms, utilization, off-hire, maintenance or disposal.
repository_evidence.operating_kpi_boundary: Campaign168 freezes generic scale and utilization KPIs. Fleet capacity and utilization require vessel-level ownership, availability, employment and downtime histories rather than aggregate scale alone.
repository_evidence.pricing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes commercial prices and sales terms. Freight or charter rates alone do not establish covered days, vessel class, counterparty, optionality, off-hire or contract performance.
repository_evidence.lease_boundary: Campaign175 freezes general lease commitments. Maritime time, voyage and bareboat charters have vessel employment, hire, bunker, port, off-hire and redelivery semantics not recoverable from accounting lease balances.
repository_evidence.owned_asset_boundary: Campaign178 freezes generic productive assets and capital expenditure. Vessel fleet identity, newbuild orderbook, delivery, class, flag, charter employment, dry-dock and demolition require a distinct lifecycle contract.
repository_evidence.sector_boundary: Point-in-time shipping sector and vessel-owning or operating scope must be frozen; non-shipping issuers remain structurally not applicable and cannot be filled with zero.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current fleet list or latest orderbook cannot be projected backward without acquisition, newbuild, delivery, charter, off-hire, dry-dock, sale, demolition, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact exchange filing, fleet table, ship registry, charter disclosure, shipyard delivery record or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable issuer, vessel, contract, document and observation identifiers

contract, acquisition, keel, launch, delivery, charter start, rate reset, option, off-hire, dry-dock, redelivery, sale, demolition, correction, first-public and supersession timestamps with trading-session availability
issuer, listed security, parent, subsidiary, vessel owner, beneficial owner, operator, charterer, manager, shipyard, lender and counterparty mapping without current-state leakage
point-in-time sector taxonomy separating vessel owner, operator, lessor, port, shipbuilder, logistics provider and non-shipping business with structural not-applicability
vessel identity, IMO number, name history, class, type, capacity, age, flag, registry, ownership, control, pooling and consolidation semantics
newbuild and second-hand order, price, deposit, financing, construction stage, cancellation, delay, delivery, warranty and refund semantics
time, voyage, bareboat, pool and contract-of-affreight taxonomy with vessel, cargo, route, rate, duration, option, redelivery and counterparty terms
available, employed, ballast, idle, laid-up, off-hire, dry-dock, repair, casualty, detention and regulatory-restriction semantics with complete downtime
hire, freight, bunker, port, commission, operating cost, maintenance, class survey and emission-compliance allocation and unit semantics
purchase, sale, impairment, mortgage, repossession, recycling, demolition, residual value and gain or loss outcome semantics
gross and net presentation, owned and chartered-in capacity, spot and fixed coverage, unit, currency, double counting, missing, undisclosed, not-applicable and true-zero semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full eligible-shipping denominator, issuer and vessel identifier history, delisting and merger coverage, identity, timing, sector, contract, downtime, disposal and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: owned_controlled_fleet_newbuild_orderbook_delivery_and_financing_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known fleet state linking owned or controlled vessels and newbuilds to identity, class, capacity, age, construction, financing, cancellation, delay and delivery.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes vessel and issuer identity, ownership and control, order and financing terms, construction stages, cancellation, delay, delivery, corrections and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: charter_in_out_contract_coverage_rate_option_and_counterparty_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known vessel employment state covering time, voyage, bareboat, pool and affreightment contracts, fixed or spot coverage, rate, term, option, counterparty and redelivery.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete vessel-contract history connecting employment, rate and duration, options, counterparty, amendment, default, termination, redelivery, correction and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: vessel_utilization_offhire_drydock_repair_and_regulatory_availability_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known operational availability state covering employment, idle and ballast days, off-hire, casualty, detention, dry-dock, repair, class survey and emission compliance.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time source preserves vessel-day availability, downtime cause and start or end, maintenance scope, class and regulatory status, recovery, corrections and complete failed-operation coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: vessel_purchase_sale_impairment_repossession_recycling_and_demolition_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known fleet-exit state covering purchase and sale, mortgage and repossession, impairment, recycling or demolition, residual proceeds, delivery and gain or loss outcomes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source connects vessel identity to transaction, mortgage, possession, impairment, sale or demolition terms, completion, failure, revisions and complete first-public history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: lease_fixed_asset_capex_freight_rate_utilization_contract_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing lease, fixed asset, capital expenditure, freight rate, utilization KPI, commercial contract or security-price state relabelled as fleet quality or charter resilience.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Adjacent aggregate states do not identify vessels, employment contracts, covered days, off-hire, maintenance, delivery, sale or demolition chains.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: fleet_capacity_age_charter_rate_coverage_utilization_direction_denominator_window_or_vessel_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of vessel count, capacity, age, orderbook, charter rate or coverage, utilization, off-hire, class, route, fuel, term or event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing young or old fleets, high or low coverage, successful deliveries only, vessel class, route, denominator, lag or window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_fleet_orderbook_charter_availability_and_disposal_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer shipping-fleet score across fleet and orderbook, charter coverage, operational availability and vessel exit outcomes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted source families or choosing normalization, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before sector scope and every base source contract are complete.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four fleet, charter, availability and disposal lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; adjacent-domain relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven scientific decisions in the Campaign186 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
